text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Not many days after the New Year's greetings came the morning of the Shinzan Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At a prestigious teahouse in Kyoto...
Gentildonna was leisurely enjoying her tea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gentildonna seemed so relaxed, it was hard to believe she was about to race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's at Kyoto Racecourse just like her debut race,
and at the same distance, so she has experience, but...
there is still one thing bothering me—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "I heard that girls who win the Shinzan Kinen often go on to achieve great results on the Classic Triple Crown trail."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Then... that means girls with the strength
to excel on that kind of route have an easier time winning, huh.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wasn't Gentildonna...
aiming for the Tiara route?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I've been keeping an eye on her, but... I wonder.
Will Gentildonna's strength really hold up in the Shinzan Kinen~?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While that isn't everything, statistically speaking,
rarely have girls from the Tiara route entered
and actually emerged victorious.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
People really do love to pigeonhole things, don't they?
I wonder if it makes them feel safer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed the voices of those around her
had reached Gentildonna's ears loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Still, I shall forgive you.
For you shall have a rude awakening today.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That my power questions nothing.
—Before that, another drink.
